name: agent-crew
description: One pane for every subagent (tabs, details, timeline), the files they read, changed and committed (history, diffs, conflicts), and the session's usage.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

showUsage.title: Show usage
showUsage.description: A framed section at the top of the panel: the session's context fill and the 5-hour and weekly limits

showTotals.title: Show session totals
showTotals.description: Shows cost, tokens and time of all subagents together at the top of the panel; each agent's own figures show either way

showTimeline.title: Show the timeline
showTimeline.description: A timeline under the subagents: when each one ran, on one shared time axis

notifyAgents.title: Notify when subagents end
notifyAgents.description: off; failures (failed or stopped ones); background (background and workflow agents, and any failure); all

limitWarnings.title: Warn about limits
limitWarnings.description: A notice when the 5-hour or weekly limit passes 80 % and 95 %, and when the context passes 85 %

warnConflicts.title: Warn about conflicting edits
warnConflicts.description: A notice, and a ⚠ in the file tree, when two agents change the same file within ten minutes

notifyVia.title: Notices as
notifyVia.description: toast: inside Claude Code; system: the terminal's or system's notification, a toast where none is sent

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on the first subagent
autoOpen.description: Opens the agents panel once per session when the first subagent starts
